deals.travelWindow: Sep 5-13 cheapest confirmed nonstop dates on Allegiant, Oct 20-27 runs $110, other Sept-Oct dates higher
deals.whyRanked: Still the cheapest verified fare of the five at $98 RT nonstop for a third straight week, and the Smokies' Sugarlands entrance is under an hour away.
deals.soloWhy: Downtown's compact grid is easy to wander alone on foot, and the park's quieter Cosby and Greenbrier entrances make for solo hikes without the Cades Cove crowds.

highlights: Ijams Nature Center's river bluffs and swimming hole
Market Square's restaurants and farmers market
Knoxville Museum of Art and the adjacent World's Fair Park
South Waterfront Riverwalk along the Tennessee River
Great Smoky Mountains NP's Cosby/Greenbrier entrance
itinerary: Day 1 — Ijams Nature Center for a river-bluff hike, Market Square for dinner and live music at night.
Day 2 — Knoxville Museum of Art in the morning, a walk along the South Waterfront Riverwalk, brewery stop in the Old City at night.
Day 3 — Rent a car for the Smokies: the Cosby entrance's Albright Grove trail before heading back to Knoxville for an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: Downtown — Market Square, World's Fair Park, and the Old City — is entirely walkable; a rental car is required for the national park.
guide.stayArea: Downtown near Market Square — walkable to restaurants and a short drive from I-40.

deals.travelWindow: Sep-Oct 2026, cheapest confirmed nonstop dates on JetBlue midweek
deals.whyRanked: $108 RT nonstop — back to a headline fare after two quiet weeks — and Niagara Falls State Park is a 25-minute drive, one of the strongest price-to-park ratios of the five.
deals.soloWhy: Downtown Buffalo's Elmwood Village and waterfront are flat, walkable, and quiet enough at night for solo strolls, and the falls make an easy no-tour-group day trip by rental car.

highlights: Buffalo's Canalside waterfront and Naval Park
Elmwood Village's shops and cafes
Darwin D. Martin House, a Frank Lloyd Wright landmark
Buffalo AKG Art Museum
Niagara Falls State Park's Cave of the Winds and Maid of the Mist
itinerary: Day 1 — Canalside and the Naval Park in the afternoon, Elmwood Village for dinner.
Day 2 — Darwin Martin House tour in the morning, Buffalo AKG Art Museum in the afternoon.
Day 3 — Drive to Niagara Falls State Park for the Maid of the Mist boat tour and Cave of the Winds before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: Downtown and Elmwood Village are walkable, with the Metro Rail free downtown; a rental car is the easiest way to Niagara Falls.
guide.stayArea: Elmwood Village or downtown near Canalside — walkable to restaurants and a short drive to I-190.

deals.travelWindow: Sep-Oct 2026, cheapest confirmed nonstop dates on JetBlue and Spirit, book 3-4 weeks out
deals.whyRanked: $178 RT nonstop across three carriers, and the Everglades' Anne Kolb/Markham Park backwaters are about 45 minutes inland.

nearbyParks.name: Everglades National Park (Everglades Holiday Park entrance)

deals.soloWhy: The free water taxi loops through downtown and the beach all day, making it easy to island-hop between neighborhoods without a car or a tour group.

highlights: Fort Lauderdale Beach's promenade
Las Olas Boulevard shops and riverfront dining
Bonnet House Museum and Gardens
Riverwalk Arts & Entertainment District
Everglades Holiday Park airboat tours
itinerary: Day 1 — Fort Lauderdale Beach in the morning, water taxi to Las Olas Boulevard for dinner.
Day 2 — Bonnet House Museum and Gardens, then the Riverwalk district in the evening.
Day 3 — Rent a car for Everglades Holiday Park's airboat tour before an afternoon flight.
guide.gettingAround: The water taxi covers downtown, Las Olas, and the beach all day; a rental car is needed for the Everglades.
guide.stayArea: Fort Lauderdale Beach or Las Olas — walkable to a water taxi stop.

deals.travelWindow: Sep-Nov 2026, cheapest confirmed nonstop dates on United and JetBlue, up from $141 two weeks ago
deals.whyRanked: $190 RT nonstop — pricier than two weeks ago — but Rocky Mountain National Park's Bear Lake corridor is still just 90 minutes from downtown, the strongest park boost of the five.
deals.soloWhy: Larimer Square and the Confluence Park trail network are flat and well-lit at night, and the free MallRide shuttle removes any guesswork about getting downtown.

highlights: Larimer Square's restored Victorian storefronts
Confluence Park where Cherry Creek meets the South Platte
Denver Central Market food hall
Denver Art Museum
Rocky Mountain National Park's Bear Lake corridor
itinerary: Day 1 — Denver Central Market for lunch, Larimer Square in the afternoon, dinner and rooftop drinks nearby.
Day 2 — Denver Art Museum in the morning, a walk or bike along Confluence Park and the Cherry Creek Trail, sunset from Cheesman Park.
Day 3 — Rent a car for Rocky Mountain NP: the Bear Lake corridor for an easy alpine hike, back to Denver for an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: The free MallRide shuttle and A Line train cover downtown and the airport; a rental car is needed for the national park.
guide.stayArea: LoDo or Uptown — walkable to Larimer Square and a MallRide stop.

deals.travelWindow: Sep-Nov 2026, cheapest confirmed nonstop dates on Delta, Southwest, or JetBlue, roughly flat on last week
deals.whyRanked: The priciest of the five at $251 RT nonstop, but Torrey Pines State Natural Reserve's cliff trails are a 20-minute trolley-and-walk from downtown and three carriers fly it nonstop.
deals.soloWhy: Balboa Park and the Gaslamp Quarter are packed with solo counter-seating and museum-hopping, and the trolley covers most of the city without a rental car.

highlights: Balboa Park's museums and Spanish Village art studios
Cabrillo National Monument's tide pools and lighthouse
Gaslamp Quarter happy hours
La Jolla Cove seals and coastal walk
Torrey Pines State Natural Reserve cliff trails
itinerary: Day 1 — Balboa Park's museums and gardens in the morning, Gaslamp Quarter happy hour and dinner at night.
Day 2 — La Jolla Cove for the seals and a coastal walk, sunset at Torrey Pines' Razor Point trail.
Day 3 — Trolley and a short walk to Cabrillo National Monument's tide pools before an afternoon flight.
guide.gettingAround: The MTS trolley and rideshares cover downtown, Balboa Park, and La Jolla without a car; Torrey Pines and Cabrillo are easiest with one.
guide.stayArea: Gaslamp Quarter or Little Italy — walkable to a trolley stop and the waterfront.
